section13_checks.prohibition_description: Treating Grant Agreement Annex templates as the governing structural schema for proposal writing.
Inventing call constraints, scope requirements, expected outcomes, or expected impacts not present in Tier 2B.
Inventing project facts (partners, capabilities, roles, objectives, budget figures) not present in Tier 3.
Commencing Phase 8 activity before the budget gate (Phase 7) has passed; budget-dependent claims without a passing gate.
Storing durable decisions only in agent memory without writing them to Tier 4.
Allowing a workflow or skill to become a de facto constitutional authority.
Silently reordering phases or weakening gate conditions to allow progress with incomplete inputs.
Finalising proposal text when source state is incomplete/contradictory/unvalidated without explicitly flagging the gap.
Using agent-local knowledge of Horizon Europe rules as a substitute for reading Tier 1 source documents.
Producing Tier 5 outputs not traceable to specific inputs in Tier 1-4.
Modifying Tier 1 or Tier 2 source documents to reflect project-specific assumptions.
Treating CLAUDE.md as advisory or optional.

check_notes.13.1: No Grant Agreement Annex, Model Grant Agreement Annex, or AGA template is used as a structural authority. The single structural cross-reference in the content is 'Part B-2 Section 5', which is an application-form (Tier 2A) reference, not a grant-annex schema source. traceability_footer contains no annex references. Pass.
check_notes.13.2: Call-requirement claims (European vs Global Fellowship provisions, optional evaluated non-academic placement, CC-07 placement window) carry Tier 2B source references in claim_statuses (scope_requirements.json SR-01, SR-02, SR-06) and traceability_footer.primary_sources includes docs/tier2b_topic_and_call_sources/extracted/scope_requirements.json. No call constraint is asserted without a Tier 2B reference. Pass.
check_notes.13.3: All project-fact claims (partners, capabilities, infrastructure, supervisors, publications, person-months) carry Tier 3 source references in claim_statuses (consortium/*, architecture_inputs/*, call_binding/*, working_assumptions.json), and traceability_footer.primary_sources enumerates the corresponding Tier 3 paths. Assumed facts (in-kind PM, placement supervisor identity/title, workspace, contacts) are marked status='assumed' with assumption_declared=true and sourced to working_assumptions.json. Pass.
check_notes.13.4: Artifact is a Phase 8 deliverable (schema_id orch.tier5.implementation_section.v1). Content contains no monetary budget figures (no '€', 'EUR' patterns). Person-month figures are effort allocations traceable to Tier 3 workpackage_seed.json (fellow_person_months, status='confirmed') or declared operator assumptions; the section explicitly states in-kind effort 'is not funded or costed by MSCA-PF and therefore does not appear in the budget', so no unvalidated budget-dependent monetary claim is finalised in this section. Budget-gate assessment file not read under the TAPM input boundary (phase_outputs is a non-mandatory read; boundary restricts reads to CLAUDE.md and artifact_path). No budget-dependent violation detected in artifact content. Pass.
